$comment: Performance budgets. Baselines are first measurements; a check fails when a value regresses past its section's allowedRegression, and a section without a baseline is reported, not failed. openingFrameTime: just perf-opening (record with: just perf-opening record), headless Chromium since #48 (ADR 0144): its frames come on a 60 Hz clock, so p50 and p95 read 16.7 ms while the onboarding frame keeps up, against WebKit's 17 and 18. startup, idleMemory, inputLatency: just perf-app on the CEF desk (DESK_E2E_SHELL=tauri for the Linux .deb), nightly in the e2e workflow's perf job; their baselines come from the CI runner (just perf-app record, or budgets.json from the job's artifact), and none was recorded on the Tauri app, so the CEF desk's first run sets them. targetMs are RT-16's targets, printed beside the values, not gates.
